children: MasterCraft Boat Holdings reported fiscal 2026 net sales of $348.9 million and a fourth-quarter net sales total of $129.9 million, reflecting year-over-year growth driven in part by the May 2026 merger with Marine Products. GAAP loss from continuing operations for the full year was $1.6 million, while Adjusted Net Income for fiscal 2026 was $30.2 million, or $1.76 per diluted share; Adjusted Net Income for Q4 was $13.5 million, or $0.67 per diluted share. The company recorded a $10.1 million non-cash impairment in the Leisure segment and incurred acquisition-related expenses tied to the Marine Products transaction during the period.
Full-year net sales: $348.9 million, up $64.7 million (22.8%) vs. prior year.
Fourth-quarter net sales: $129.9 million, up $50.4 million (63.4%) vs. prior year; Q4 included $33.3 million incremental sales from the Marine Products transaction.
Gross profit: $79.8 million for fiscal 2026; gross margin 22.9% for fiscal 2026 (up 290 bps vs. prior year). Q4 gross profit $29.3 million; Q4 gross margin 22.6% (down 60 bps vs. prior year).
GAAP results: Loss from continuing operations for fiscal 2026 of $1.6 million (diluted $(0.09) per share); Q4 loss from continuing operations $7.0 million (diluted $(0.35) per share).

Non-GAAP: Adjusted Net Income for fiscal 2026 $30.2 million, or $1.76 per diluted share; Q4 Adjusted Net Income $13.5 million, or $0.67 per diluted share. Adjusted EBITDA for fiscal 2026 $45.6 million; Q4 Adjusted EBITDA $20.5 million.
Completed merger with Marine Products on May 15, 2026, creating the Recreation and Sport Fishing segment and contributing incremental net sales and operating expenses in Q4.
Performance and Wake segment (formerly MasterCraft) showed unit and revenue growth, supported by rollout of the next-generation X-Series product family and favorable premium mix.
Leisure segment recorded a $10.1 million non-cash impairment related to other intangible assets due to updated fair-value projections.

Company announced fiscal year-end change from June 30 to December 31 effective July 1, 2026; will file a transition report for the six months ending December 31, 2026 and provided Transition Period guidance for net sales, Adjusted EBITDA, and Adjusted EPS.
Reported operational initiatives including ERP implementation and organizational realignment; incurred related implementation and transition costs during fiscal 2026.
